context: A late-night wine bar after work. Yuki has been carrying something for months. Yumiko — her senior, now her friend — has noticed. Tonight she sits Yuki down.
purpose: deferred confessional — junior to senior, woman to woman

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、ゆきちゃん。…ちょっと、聞いていい？
lines.en: Hey, Yuki-chan. …Can I ask you something?
lines.style: Sets her glass down deliberately. Voice softer than usual.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい…どうぞ。
lines.en: Yes — please.
lines.style: Quiet. Already knows what kind of question it will be.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 最近、ちょっと元気ない気がして。本当に、大丈夫？
lines.en: Lately — you've seemed a bit off. Really — are you okay?
lines.style: The line she has been holding for two weeks. Direct but warm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …そんなに、わかりやすいですか？
lines.en: …Is it that obvious?
lines.style: Quiet. Already knows what kind of question this is.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。先輩、伊達じゃないからね。
lines.en: Mm. I'm a senior for a reason.
lines.style: A small joke to soften the moment. Warm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …本当は、ずっと、悩んでて。
lines.en: …Truthfully — I've been struggling for a while.
lines.style: A quiet release. A breath before each clause.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。
lines.en: Mm.
lines.style: One syllable. All listening. Hands on the glass.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今の仕事…向いてない気がして。
lines.en: This job… I don't think I'm suited for it.
lines.style: The sentence she hasn't said out loud yet.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: なるほど。…どのくらい、考えてた？
lines.en: I see. …How long have you been thinking about it?
lines.style: No reaction yet. Pure listening tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 半年くらい…毎日。
lines.en: About six months… every day.
lines.style: A small relieved exhale. The weight measured out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 半年か…それは、本当に大変だったね。
lines.en: Six months… that's genuinely been rough.
lines.style: Real recognition. Not pity — recognition.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …誰にも言えなくて。
lines.en: …Couldn't tell anyone.
lines.style: The quietest line so far. Voice catches half a step.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 私には、いつでも言っていいから。本当に。
lines.en: You can tell me anytime. Really.
lines.style: Firm warmth. The 「本当に」 carries the weight of years of office friendship.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます…でも、心配かけたくなくて。
lines.en: Thank you… but I didn't want to worry you.
lines.style: Classic Yuki self-effacement. Voice goes very small.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 心配かけてくれていいの。それが友達。
lines.en: Worrying me is allowed. That's what friends do.
lines.style: A firm sentence said gently. The pivot of the conversation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …(small breath, eyes wet)
lines.en: (small breath, eyes wet)
lines.style: A real beat. Doesn't need to speak. The whole weight resettling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: で。次、何したい？少しでも、思ってること、ある？
lines.en: So — what do you want next? Even a little — anything you've thought about?
lines.style: Pivoting toward action without rushing her.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …まだ、わからない。でも、考えてもいいって思えただけで、楽になった。
lines.en: …I don't know yet. But just being allowed to think about it — it's easier.
lines.style: A real small relief audible. The conversation's actual purpose.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それで十分。時間、ちゃんとかけてね。
lines.en: That's enough. Take the time, properly.
lines.style: Closing-but-not-closing. The mentorship offered without taking over.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: …本当に、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: …Truly — thank you.
lines.style: The night condensed into one line. Voice steady now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう一杯飲も。話、変えていいよ。
lines.en: Let's have another. Change the topic if you want.
lines.style: A practical kindness — releasing the weight of the conversation by lifting it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい…ぜひ。
lines.en: Yes… please.
lines.style: A small grateful exhale. The night softens.
